### 🍖 Hunger & thirst
- Survival now has two needs that slowly drain: hunger and thirst. Keep both bars up and your health mends itself over time; let either fall and natural healing stops.
- Run a meter all the way to empty and it starts draining your health — an empty belly or a dry canteen will kill you if you keep ignoring it. The two stack, so being both starving and parched runs you down twice as fast.
- Food no longer heals on the spot. A meal fills your belly, and a full belly is what lets you heal. Medkits and bandages are still your only instant heals in a fight.

### 🥩 Living off the land
- Hunt animals for raw meat, or forage berries to take the edge off between hunts.
- Cook meat over the fire so it feeds far more, or simmer a haunch with berries into a stew — one bowl, one slot, instead of eating everything piece by piece.

### 💧 Canteens
- Craft a canteen once and it comes back to you every time you drink from it — fill it at any pond, then boil it over the fire for a clean, filling drink, or drink it raw if you're desperate.
- Raw pond water slakes your thirst but can make you sick — the fire is what makes it safe.

### ⚒️ Forged iron tools
- Smelt iron ore into ingots on the campfire, then forge an iron axe and pick. They fell more with every swing and last far longer than the stone tools.

### 🪓 Tools wear out
- Axes and picks now wear down as you work and eventually break — watch the wear bar and keep a spare.

### 🔥 The campfire is a workshop now
- Burn logs into charcoal, smelt ore into scrap for ammo or into ingots for tools, cook meat, simmer stew, and boil water. Jobs run while you're away — set them going and come back to a full tray.

### 🌄 A longer view
- The survival world now draws distant hills and treelines far past where the detailed ground ends, so the horizon opens up instead of dropping into fog a few steps ahead.

### 🙂 More lifelike faces
- Other players (and your own reflection in the character screen) have reshaped faces now, with softer lighting on skin — and they blink and glance around on their own.

### 🔫 Weapon balance
- The magnum fires noticeably faster and now has the best damage-per-second of the handguns — and it can drop a player in two shots, or one to the head.
- The pistol hits a touch softer: six body shots to down a player instead of five.
- The fast SMG carries a full 30-round magazine now and hits a little harder, putting it on par with the assault rifles for sustained fire.

### 🏹 Arrows can headshot
- A well-placed arrow now lands a headshot on another player, same as bullets.

### 🎬 The sixth test
- Starting a new survival world now opens with a scene: four days after the bite, strapped to a gurney, still talking — and a sister with a plan for the gate.
- It plays once per world. A new game plays it again; continuing one you already started does not.
- Skippable at any point with the on-screen button.

### 🏥 Medical & lab props
- Five new props for the map and structure editors, under a new Medical & Lab category: a hospital gurney, a drip stand, a vitals monitor, a supply trolley and a wall cabinet.
- Shots pass between the gurney's side rails instead of stopping on thin air.

### 👀 Faces that are alive
- Characters in a scene blink, and their jaws move while they speak.
